about_the_game:
Dive into the world of anime puzzles with the new DLC, which adds 20 unique and exciting levels filled with completely naked 18+ anime girls. Each puzzle provides you with an exciting challenge, as well as incredible graphics that will truly bring each picture to life.

Features:

  • 20 new levels with beautiful anime drawings full of erotic context.

  • Auto-pass: if you want to complete a level without effort, use the auto-pass function to simply enjoy the visual process (auto-pass is added to all levels, including the main ones).

  • Gallery of completed levels: Return to your favorite paintings, view all the puzzles you've already solved in the gallery, and admire the results of your work.

  • 20 new achievements: For those who like to compete, this DLC adds unique achievements for each completed level.

Warning: The DLC contains 18+ content, which is intended for adult users only. Make sure you meet the age restrictions before purchasing.
